svg.text: the four-link chain: one joint error, four times, and where the tip ends up
512 Monte-Carlo samples, seed 0x4d435f4531315f31 — ADVISORY (E11.1): every number here is an estimate over draws, and none of it gates
study: 4 links of 12 mm, each joint an independent normal at σ = 0.01 rad (0.57°) — tip asserted within 1.00 mm of the target
tip position over the draws: mean 0.5459 mm, σ 0.4171 mm, range [0.0018, 2.7692] mm — 1.95% of draws fell outside the analyzed box
19 px/mm — all 512 samples, every link outline walked off the body that sample built; the bar at each joint is that joint's MEASURED lateral range
48 px/mm — the same 512 samples' tip pins against the target and its 1.00 mm band
the dispersion down the chain, measured against the accumulation law
joint j turns links j..4, so pin k carries (k−j) link lengths of lever from joint j — the quadrature sum below
tip against the target: mean 0.5459 mm, σ 0.4171 mm, worst 2.7692 mm
advisory yield against the 1.00 mm band: 439 of 512 hold, 73 violate
blue: one outline per sample per link, at 0.04 opacity — each walked off the cap face of the body that sample built
purple: the joint pins, each a Surface::Cylinder read off that body, with its axis point as a dot; the bars are the measured lateral ranges
dashed orange: the nominal chain, every joint at zero. dashed green: the target pin and the asserted position band
teal: the CERTIFIED enclosure per joint — exact over a box, and silent outside it. The widest box that certifies THIS chain whole is 1.318e-7 of the study.
— across the chain it grows 1 : 3 : 6 : 10, the WORST-CASE lever sum; the advisory σ grows 1 : 2.24 : 3.74 : 5.48, the quadrature sum.
— any side under 5 px is drawn at 5 px about its pin (on the whole chain: both sides); the table has the true half-widths.
ADVISORY: draws from the WHOLE distribution, tail included, which is 7.59e6 times the certified box. Its numbers summarize these 512 chains — which is what the panels are.
